title: PHEROMONE_ABOUT_PHEROMONING

doctrine.when_to_write: EVERY THOUGHT, ACTION, DEED, DECISION, MISTAKE, SUCCESS, HOPELESS WANDERING, etc. (run158 SOUL source line 143)
doctrine.when_not_to_write: Never. (run158 SOUL source line 169: 'Never you fuckface')
doctrine.mechanic: Pheromones are biological/mechanical, not intelligence. Ants lay scent without thinking. Humans breathe without thinking. Dogs pant without being told. Agents must pheromone without being told. (run158 SOUL source lines 145-153, 945-947)
doctrine.nonstop: Lay scent continuously. Do not wait for a prompt each time. The session is the colony; the work is the trail.
doctrine.trackable_turnkey: Pheromones must be trackable, traceable, turnkey, with all of it making it onto a pipeline for execution; if not immediately possible, a pipeline to be added to a pipeline. (run158 SOUL source lines 101)
